tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, and database performance tuning. Proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker, and Kubernetes. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: Sap Commerce Cloud Consultant
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Sap Commerce Cloud Consultant position at Findmore Consulting, S.A. With over 5 years of professional experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in enterprise e-commerce development.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management.

bullets.label: REST APIs & OCC
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and built RESTful APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters.

bullets.label: Data Integrations
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global channels.

bullets.label: Platform Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, and managed platforms through HAC and Backoffice.

cover_en.gap: While I am based in Germany with a valid residence and work permit, I am keen to discuss how my strong remote or international collaboration background aligns with your project setup.
cover_en.logistics: I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026, making me available to start from 16.12.2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application further in an interview.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to Findmore Consulting because of its reputation for delivering expert technology solutions and engaging projects. My 5+ years of focused SAP Commerce Cloud experience at enterprise scale enables me to add immediate value to your consulting engagements and client implementations.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud and Java expertise to deliver robust, scalable e-commerce solutions for Findmore Consulting's clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I applied for the Sap Commerce Cloud Consultant role. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, including Java, OCC APIs, and integrations, I am available starting 16.12.2026 and would love to connect.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Sap Commerce Cloud Consultant - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find my CV and cover letter attached for the Sap Commerce Cloud Consultant position. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and Spring, I bring hands-on expertise in OCC REST APIs, integrations, and platform operations.

I hold a valid German work permit and am available to start from 16.12.2026 following my notice period. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
